findings.text: the dry-run admission is computed with no own_run_id or own_registered_at, so it cannot model the two racing-claim exemptions the real dispatch applies at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6739: an earlier-registered peer whose claim has not launched and is later withdrawn makes the real dispatch proceed after the bounded wait at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:7290 while the preview reports scope-conflict, which is the false refusal the plan's measure forbids; narrow, because it needs the racing window and the preview runs before the node registers.

the fixture backend command was changed from worker to codex to let the new real-dispatch assertions reach launch; under the original command the real dispatch fails at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6893 with CrewError D22 (no launch translation for 'worker') while the dry run still reports admission admitted at exit 0, so the gate demonstrates dry-run prediction only for a launch-translatable backend and leaves the D22 refusal unmodelled, a gap outside this node's declared scope.
